brief:
Residents of Khillet al-Farra, a small community west of Yatta in the West Bank, face prolonged hardship stemming from the absence of essential services, the Palestine News Network reported. The village, situated near the border with al-Samu, has contended with deteriorating living conditions that complicate routine daily activities for its inhabitants and leave them struggling to meet fundamental needs.

Local officials and residents have documented the toll of service deficiencies on health, education, and economic stability across the area. Khillet al-Farra remains one of several Palestinian settlements in the region grappling with infrastructure challenges that persist year after year, constraining opportunities for development and improvement in residents' quality of life.

title: Palestinian village west of Yatta endures years without basic services
